ctx.x: Homer Simeon studied from the young Thiel, too.

You find all of those boys are a product of those Thiel brothers. Albert Nicholas. And you find... Albert Nicholas. Barnaby Godd. Barnaby Godd, all of that. All of those boys are of that same school.
